title: DAY 10/90
BEAM DEFLECTION
scenes.sub: 100 days to GATE: how far does it bend?
scenes.voice: Day ten of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge, and exactly one hundred days to GATE! Back to Strength of Materials: today we ask how far a loaded beam actually bends.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Today's subject is Strength of Materials. Our topic: deflection of beams, a favourite for two mark numericals.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover the double integration method, Macaulay's method for multiple loads, the moment area theorems, and the standard slope and deflection results.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. A cantilever with a tip load deflects P L cubed by three E I. A simply supported beam with a central load, P L cubed by forty eight E I. Sixteen times less!

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Solve the free practice set on Telegram first. Then take tonight's deflection test, seven to nine P. M., in our one rupee challenge course. Toppers in the next reel!

scenes.title: Day 9 Toppers
scenes.voice: Day nine toppers! Rank one, Sweta Rani Sahoo, top again with twenty six point three three! Rank two, Divyanshi Pandey. Rank three, Atharva Vyas. Congratulations!
